title: At release all twelve standard terms are active and the shop has none of its own
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the organization existed before the release, and nobody has used the Credit Terms page since.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • It lists exactly the twelve standard terms: COD, Due on Receipt, Net 7, Net 15, Net 20, Net 30, Net 45, Net 50, Net 60, Net 90, Net 120, Credit Hold, and its count reads 12.

Step 2:

  • It reads "No inactive terms" with a count of 0.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S11-R3: “All twelve standard terms are active at release, and no organization has its own terms.”
  • Terminology: “Standard term → One of the twelve terms every organization has: COD, Due on Receipt, Net 7, Net 15, Net 20, Net 30, Net 45, Net 50, Net 60, Net 90, Net 120, Credit Hold.”
  • Goals: “With no setup at all, existing shops behave exactly as before release (default COD, the same twelve terms), and new shops start on Due on Receipt.”
